simSubtitle: What-if simulation from your assumptions — not actual data.
simBanner: SCENARIO — not actual data. Numbers here are computed from your assumptions and are not saved.
simInputsHint: Enter the monthly fixed cost (overhead + journal), then volume, unit cost, and selling price per service. Price can be picked per SKU.
skuHint: List prices and SKU availability for invoicing. Seats follow the tier cap, not here.
bundleHint: Owner-locked bundle price vs the à-la-carte sum, plus the annual policy.
bundleLockedNotice: These are owner-locked commercial numbers (2026-10-12). The saving is derived from the line prices above — changing a line price changes this table.
skuLockWarning: List prices are commercial decisions. Editing a price does not change past invoices — each invoice stores the amount at creation.
skuSeatsReadonly: Seats follow the tier cap and cannot be edited here. Open the tier to change them.
simPriceMissing: SKU price is missing from the catalog — enter it manually or set it in the SKU Catalog.
simCostFromHpp: Unit cost is prefilled from the HPP report (real cost per job). You can override it.
simGuideHint: Steps, formulas, and limits of the simulation.
simGuideStep1: Enter the monthly fixed cost (overhead + journal) — one lump sum for all services.
simGuideStep2: For each service, enter the volume (units/customers you assume).
simGuideStep3: Unit cost (COGS) is prefilled from the HPP report — override it if you assume a different cost.
simGuideStep4: Pick a SKU to prefill the selling price from the SKU price list — override it if needed.
simGuideStep5: Read the HPP, margin, margin %, and break-even (BEP) columns.
simGuideStep6: Optional: enter a target margin to see the target price per service.
simGuideFixedCostTitle: How the fixed cost is split
simGuideFixedCostBody: The fixed cost is allocated proportionally to volume, with the rounding remainder going to the last service that has volume. A service with volume 0 gets no share — fill volume for every service you want to bear fixed cost.
simGuideFormulaBody: HPP = volume x unit cost. Fully loaded = HPP + fixed-cost share. Margin = revenue - fully loaded. Margin % = round(margin x 100 / revenue). BEP = ceil(fixed share / (price - unit cost)). Target price = (unit cost + fixed share / volume) / (1 - target margin).
simGuideNotComputedBody: Shown when unit cost plus fixed share is zero, or when volume is zero. The page never shows a confident percentage while cost is empty, because that number would be misleading.
simGuideLimit1: Nothing is saved — refreshing or leaving the page clears your inputs.
simGuideLimit2: This page never changes real data: no writes to HPP rates, overhead, journal, catalog, or invoices.
simGuideLimit3: Uptime and Guard are billed as à-la-carte lines, but their revenue here is still an assumption — it is not tied to a specific paid invoice.
simGuideLimit4: Seat caps are not applied here — caps are enforced when assets are created, not in what-if math.
simGuideLimit5: The price here is an assumption, not the official price. To change the real SKU price, use the SKU Catalog page.
skuGuideHint: Prices here are selling prices, not costs. Saved changes affect future invoices only.
skuGuideStep1: Edit the list price for a row — this is the selling price, not the cost.
skuGuideStep2: Tick Invoicable if the SKU should be billable on new manual invoices.
skuGuideStep3: Click Save to review your edits; no change is written yet.
skuGuideStep4: Confirm in the dialog after checking the old and new price and any Invoicable change.
skuGuidePricingBody: The list price is revenue from selling the SKU; COGS is managed on the HPP page. Saving changes future invoices only. An issued invoice retains the amount recorded when it was created.
skuGuideInvoicableBody: Invoicable controls whether this SKU can be added as a line on a manually created invoice. It does not set the price, create an invoice, reprice issued invoices, or change capacity or seat caps.
skuGuideLimit1: Seats are read-only here; they follow the tier cap and are set elsewhere.
skuGuideLimit2: Bundle and annual terms are owner-locked quote constants, not editable rows or an invoiced bundle.
skuGuideLimit3: Saves require confirmation, are audited with updated_by and updated_at, and accept only non-negative integer prices.
hppGuideHint: Unit rates are production costs (COGS), not selling prices. Selling prices live in the SKU Catalog.
hppGuideStep1: Enter the real per-unit cost (COGS) in the Unit rates card, then Save each key.
hppGuideStep2: Optionally set monthly overhead and add dated lines to the cost journal.
hppGuideStep3: Choose the report date range for completed activity and dated costs.
hppGuideStep4: Read the line-margin cards and the report totals to review the estimate.
hppGuideSourcesBody: Unit rates are COGS, not selling prices; selling prices are in the SKU Catalog. ip/domain/apk/ipa count completed scan jobs; hostscan counts completed Host Protect scans; statushost counts legacy status-hostname debits; uptimemonitor counts enabled monitors; guardagent counts active agents.
hppGuideFormulaBody: HPP = rate × counted volume. Fully loaded = HPP + overhead share. Monthly overhead plus the dated journal is added once per requested report and allocated by unit count; the last unit receives any rounding remainder, or overhead remains unallocated if there are no units. Margin = revenue − fully loaded. Revenue is estimated from qualifying organization inventory at catalog list prices, not paid invoices.
hppGuideRangeBody: The date range filters completed Scan events (ip/domain/apk/ipa), legacy status-hostname debits (statushost), and completed Host Protect scans (hostscan). uptimemonitor counts currently enabled monitors and guardagent counts currently active, non-disabled agents: both use live inventory, are not date-filtered, and their counts do not change with the range.
hppGuideLimit1: The report is a cost and margin estimate, not invoice profit.
hppGuideLimit2: Enterprise organizations are quote-only and excluded from list-price revenue.
hppGuideLimit3: Displayed Host margin caps its COGS at included cadence if recorded scans exceed that cadence; raw HPP stays unchanged.
hppGuideLimit4: Overhead is allocated once per report, or left unallocated if there are no units. Edits made before Save and date filters are not persisted.

tierGuideBody: A tier sets its label, rank, feature gates, product caps, workspace seat limits, and prices. Deactivation retires a tier for new choices while organizations already on it keep working (grandfathered). Permanent delete is only allowed when no organization, subscription, invoice, or request references the tier.
